title: QueryManager: silent failure when reconnect fails before exec
description:
In src/modules/query/querymanager.cpp, ensureDatabaseConnection() can fail and initDatabase() is called as fallback, but several query paths then proceed to QSqlQuery::exec() without re-checking m_db.isOpen(). On hard reconnect failure, queries silently return empty results.

Fix:
- After reconnect attempt, assert/check m_db.isOpen(); on failure emit ErrorContext(DatabaseConnectionFailed) and bail
- Always log query.lastError().text() with ErrorContext when exec() returns false
- Add a regression test that opens then forces close, then re-runs a query and verifies error signal fires
close_reason: Added ensureDatabaseAvailable() helper that wraps reconnect+init+isOpen check and emits errorOccurred(DatabaseConnectionFailed) on full failure. Replaced 9 duplicated call-site patterns. Sites that have observable result signals (loadAllCollections, loadItems, loadItemsWithSubcollections) now also emit empty-result safe defaults so the main thread doesn't hang.

title: Tiles missing titles after adding new collection — restart required
description: After adding a new collection, all tiles are missing their titles and only the placeholder tile is shown. A manual refresh does not fix it; an application restart is required for tiles to render correctly. The collection-add flow should fully refresh the tile state without needing a restart.
notes:
Investigation notes (2026-05-05, EtherAura):

User confirms reproducible after adding ANY new subcollection (always added as child of currently-viewed parent).

Traced flows but could not pinpoint the corruption:

1. Add-collection flow [src/ui/dialogs/settingsdialogtree.cpp:303-383] creates empty CollectionConfig, emits collectionSaved. m_rescanRequired only populated via subsequent handleSaveCollection (settingsdialogsetup.cpp:86-88) when the user fills mediaDirectory and clicks Save Collection.

2. On dialog accept [settingsdialog.cpp:148-167], rescanRequired emits ONE collection: originalCurrentCollectionIndex if present in the set, else first item. For new-subcollection case, the parent didn't change, so emits for the new subcollection (D), not the parent (A).

3. settingsdialogcontroller.cpp openSettingsDialog:
   - detectChanges sets needsReload=true (size grew).
   - handleReloadRequired (line 429): isNewCollection=false for viewingCollectionIndex (parent A). mediaDirectoryChanged=false. Cache/artwork clear branch SKIPPED. scrollManager->cleanup() runs. safeReloadCollection(A) timer-deferred.
   - rescanRequired handler (line 295) timer-deferred: forceRescanCollection(D) → invalidates D's (empty) cache → safeReloadCollection(D).

4. safeReloadCollection is debounced [navigationmanagerfilter.cpp:166] — m_pendingSafeReloadCollectionIndex is overwritten by last call. Final timer reload reroutes to currentCollectionIndex (A) via line 195-205.

5. So the parent A view does eventually reload via requestItemCountForContext(A). Should refresh tiles correctly.

KEY QUESTION I COULD NOT ANSWER: "manual refresh does not fix it; restart does" — what state survives reload but not restart? Static caches: ArtworkUtils::DirectoryCache (singleton, cleared on collection change in showCollectionItems:191), ItemWidget statics (s_titleTintSaturation, s_customFontFamily, s_showTitleInPlaceholder etc.) — none look like they would corrupt per add-collection.

Possible angle worth checking: WidgetPoolManager state. Pool widgets may be reused with stale m_hideTitles / m_hideSubcollectionTitles flags. Refresh might not reset pool state but restart obviously does.

Also worth: instrument with KARTEND_RANGE_DIAG=1 / KARTEND_SEARCH_DIAG=1 during repro to see whether names hash arrives correctly post-add.
close_reason: Closed

title: Allow launching ROM paths containing shell metacharacters
description: Launching a ROM such as /mnt/Games/Arcade/Collections/Sega - Mega Drive - Genesis/ROMs/Sonic & Knuckles (World) (Beta) (1994-06-10).zip currently fails with 'Path contains shell metacharacters'. File paths should be passed safely as process arguments and should not be rejected just because they contain characters like ampersand.
notes:
Root cause: LaunchManager::buildLaunchCommand validates media and core paths via PathUtils::validatePathSecurity(), whose shell metacharacter regex rejects '&'. Implemented fix: PathUtils::validatePathSecurity no longer rejects ampersands, preserving checks for semicolon, pipe, backtick, dollar, redirects, nulls, newlines, backslashes, and Unicode normalization. Added LaunchManager and PathUtils regression coverage for Sonic & Knuckles paths. Quality gate passed: .scripts/build.sh --tests --run-tests.
close_reason: Fixed launch validation so ampersands in ROM paths are allowed when passed as QProcess arguments; added regression tests and passed .scripts/build.sh --tests --run-tests.

title: List mode artwork preview icons disappear after changing list row height
description: In list view, after changing a collection's listRowHeight setting (e.g. 32 -> 24), the right-column artwork preview icons (view-preview button per row that has artwork) stop rendering. Reverting listRowHeight to 32 and restarting the app does NOT restore the icons. Reproduced on collection 'Games > Sega > Mega Drive - Genesis'. Persisted state in ~/.config/kartend/kartend.cfg looks healthy (listRowHeight=32, listArtworkColumnWidth=128). Suspect: button sizing/icon-size interaction in ItemWidget when row height shrinks below default QPushButton icon padding.
notes: Root cause: configureArtworkForWidget only handled grid-mode (queued pixmap via addPendingArtwork); for list-mode widgets it never called setHasArtwork. Initial createMediaItemWidget for list mode used findArtworkForFileCached, which returns {} on cold cache and sets hasArtwork=false. The post-prewarm reconfigureArtworkForActiveWidgets safety net then ran, but configureArtworkForWidget did not update list-mode widgets' hasArtwork flag, leaving the artwork button forever hidden. Fix: in configureArtworkForWidget, when widget->isListMode(), call widget->setHasArtwork(!artworkPath.isEmpty()) and return (skip addPendingArtwork, which is wasted for list mode). All 23 tests pass.

title: Search results: middle item won't launch; Enter clears search and breaks view
description: Repro: open a collection, type a search query that returns only a few results, double-click a result that is NOT the first in the list ("near the middle"). Nothing happens. Pressing Enter then clears the search and the grid renders only blank item placeholders (no titles, no artwork). Refresh does not recover; the application must be restarted. The same item launches normally when not filtered through search.\n\nThis suggests the search result row index is being mapped to the wrong underlying item index when launch is triggered, and the post-clear refresh path leaves visual indices pointing at stale data.
notes:
Root cause: the visual-index-vs-actual-index discriminator was wrong in 5 places when a search filter was active. \`processEnterOrReturnKey\` (interactionmanagerenter.cpp:58) compared the filtered visual index directly to subs.size(), so pressing Enter on a media-item visual position whose index happened to be < (raw subcollection count) called handleEnterOnSubcollection with subs[currentSelection] — navigating into an arbitrary child collection. That side-effect cleared the search and replaced the grid with placeholders.

Same bug pattern was in handleEnterOnSubcollection (used currentSelection, not the actual sub index), SelectionManager::updateFilePathForSelection (cleared m_selectedFilePath for filtered media items), SelectionManager::titleForIndex, SelectionManager::titleForIndexInColl, and InteractionManager::titleForIndexInColl.

Fix: route every check through ScrollManager::getFilteredIndex(visualIndex) → actualIndex, then compare actualIndex against subs.size() and index subs[actualIndex]. titleForIndexInColl only honors the filter mapping when the queried collection is the current one (other collections operate in their raw index space).

Verified: build clean, ctest 23/23 pass.
REOPENED: user reports no behavioral change after the filter-aware index discrimination fix. Need to re-investigate.
Real root cause: discriminator was using the wrong source of truth. getSubcollections(currentColl) returns the FULL parent's children from the hierarchy cache, but during search NavigationManager::onItemCountLoaded filters the visible subcollection list down to only those whose name matches (often zero) and stores it as context.subcollectionOverride; the rendered scroll data only contains those subs.

Meanwhile m_filterManager->isFiltered() is FALSE for the DB-backed search modes (CurrentCollection / CurrentAndSubcollections / AllCollections) since those bypass FilterManager entirely. So getFilteredIndex(visualIndex) returns visualIndex unchanged for the buggy path, making the previous getFilteredIndex-only fix a no-op.

For a parent with 3 hidden subs and 5 matching media items, the visible layout is just [m0..m4] with renderedSubCount=0. The old code computed subs.size()=3 from the hierarchy cache, so:
- Enter on visualIndex=1 (m1) -> handleEnterOnSubcollection(subs[1]) -> navigates into a wrong child collection. Side effect clears search and breaks the grid.
- Double-click: EventManager::handleMouseDoubleClick computed subCount+folderCount=3+0, returned false (passed through), but widget is media so no signal -> 'nothing happens'.

Fix: always use the *rendered* counts via m_scrollManager->getSubcollectionCount() / getVirtualFolderCount(), and resolve the underlying subcollection index via m_scrollManager->getDataManager()->subcollectionIndexFromActual(actualIndex). Sites fixed: EventManager::handleMouseDoubleClick, InteractionManager::processEnterOrReturnKey + handleEnterOnSubcollection (signature changed to take resolved subCollIdx directly), SelectionManager::updateFilePathForSelection / titleForIndex / titleForIndexInColl, InteractionManager::titleForIndexInColl. Build clean, ctest 23/23 pass.
close_reason: Closed

title: Wait for cache initialize() task before destroying CacheManager
description: ApplicationManager::initialize() launches a QtConcurrent::run([this]() { m_cacheManager->initialize(); }) and discards the QFuture. If shutdown begins before that task completes (fast quit, crash early in lifetime), m_cacheManager is destroyed while the worker thread is still inside initialize() holding its mutex — UB. Fix: store the QFuture as a member and waitForFinished() at the start of shutdown() before any cache-touching work.

title: Settings dialog: reduce menu clutter and fix alignment issues
description:
The settings dialog has grown cluttered with nested tabs (Collections > Configuration/Appearance/Subfolders/Sidebar > Layout/Titles/Colors/List Mode — 3 levels deep), and the addition of new options has introduced visible alignment problems across several panes.

## Observed alignment issues (see settingsscreenshots/)

- **Appearance > Layout** (1.jpg): 'View Type:', 'Grid Layout:', 'Item Layout:' act as row-group labels but share their row with inline field labels ('Alignment:', 'H-Space:', 'V-Space:', 'Height:', 'Radius:'). The different input widths (e.g. '7' vs '275') and spinbox column widths cause inconsistent field start positions and ragged columns.
- **Appearance > List Mode** (2.jpg): 'Row Size:' is a group label on the same row as 'Text Size:' and 'Row Height:' inline labels — inconsistent with other panes where each field has its own row.
- **Appearance > Titles** (7.jpg): 'Titles:' mixes a group label with 'Font Size:', 'Hide Titles', and 'Hide Subcollection Titles' on one row, while 'Custom Font:' is a standard labelled row — inconsistent patterning.
- **Appearance > Colors** (8.jpg): Most rows use a right-aligned label column, but the 'Title Text:' row breaks the pattern by inlining 'Saturation:' and 'Lightness:' sub-labels, misaligning with the color-picker column above and below.
- **General > General** (9.jpg): Label widths vary wildly ('Remember Selection:' vs 'Grid View Click-Hold Repeat:') so the input column starts at different x positions per row. Input widths also differ (spinboxes vs combobox), producing ragged right edges.
- **General > Controls** (4.jpg): Keyboard and Gamepad sections each have their own label column widths ('Move Up:' vs 'Confirm Button:'), so the two grouped sections don't share an input column.
- **Collections > Subfolders** (6.jpg) and **Collections > Sidebar** (3.jpg): mostly fine, but feel underpopulated — good candidates for merging with Configuration to reduce tab depth.

## Goals

1. Flatten/reorganize the nested tab hierarchy so settings are easier to find (target: at most 2 levels of navigation).
2. Use a single, consistent two-column form layout per pane: right-aligned label column + left-aligned control column, with uniform label/control column widths across sibling sections.
3. Replace inline multi-field rows (e.g. Grid Layout width/h-space/v-space) with either (a) a sub-form grouped under a section header with its own aligned columns, or (b) one field per row.
4. Group related colors and title options to improve discoverability.
5. Ensure tab order and keyboard navigation remain sensible after the reorg.

## Acceptance criteria

- No pane mixes group labels with inline field labels on the same row.
- All label columns within a pane align to the same x coordinate; all controls start at the same x.
- Tab navigation depth reduced (e.g. merge Subfolders/Sidebar into Configuration, or promote to top-level tabs).
- Visual review of all settings screens shows no ragged columns.
- Screenshots updated and attached to this issue on completion.

title: Set up Qt integration-test harness for UI-coordinator managers
description:
Most top-level managers (ApplicationManager, NavigationManager, ScrollManager, InteractionManager) directly include ui_*.h headers and reference the full UI widget graph. Pure unit tests are not viable for them — they need an integration harness with QApplication, MainWindow scaffolding, and the full ~50-TU link closure per binary.

Scope:
- Decide whether to use one shared integration binary (cheaper to maintain, slower per-test) or per-manager binaries.
- Provide a fixture that builds a minimal MainWindow without opening real settings/session files (use QStandardPaths::setTestModeEnabled(true)).
- Add AUTOMOC/AUTOUIC to the test target and ensure the AUTOUIC search paths are configured.
- Document the pattern in docs/testing.md so future manager tests follow it.

Once the harness exists, Kartend-crr (ApplicationManager lifecycle) and Kartend-rzw (NavigationManager) become small follow-ups.
notes: Refactored kartend executable into kartend_lib OBJECT library + thin main.cpp exe so the same TU set can be reused by tests. AUTOMOC/AUTOUIC inherited from top-level CMake; AUTOUIC search paths already configured. LTO link options propagate via INTERFACE link options on kartend_lib so tests link cleanly in Release. title: Kart system (monolithic content packages)
description: Define and consume 'Kart' packages: monolithic bundles of media + metadata + config.
design:
Kart container format design (locked 2026-05-05):

FORMAT: Custom binary container, single forward pass, zero hard deps beyond Qt.
  Header: magic 'KART\0\0\0\1' (8B) + manifest_len u32 LE + manifest JSON UTF-8
  Entries: flags u8 + path_len u16 LE + path UTF-8 + size u64 LE + sha256 32B + data
  Flag bits: 0=compressed, 1=media, 2=artwork, 3=video, 4=manual, 5-7=reserved
  Endian: little-endian on disk.

COMPRESSION: zstd 1.5.x via find_package(zstd) — OPTIONAL CMake dep.
  If found, KARTEND_HAS_ZSTD compile flag set; entries use zstd.
  Fallback: qCompress (zlib). Compression skipped for already-compressed media types
  (mp4, mkv, png, jpg, zip, 7z, gz, etc — see extensionutils).

MANIFEST: JSON. Top-level: kart_format_version, uuid, version, created_at, name,
  author, description, license, collection_config (full CollectionConfig), launchers
  (inlined from preset registry), items[] with media_path, title, metadata, launcher_index,
  artwork_path, video_path, manual_path.

INTEGRITY: per-entry sha256, verified on extract. Mismatch => abort + reportable error.

IMPORT MODEL: user picks destination dir; reader extracts files there, registers a new
  collection in CollectionConfig, inlines launcher presets if missing, writes
  item_metadata rows. On (collection_uuid, path) collision => MERGE PROMPT (per-collection
  Skip/Overwrite/Merge with user-chosen field policy).

EXPORT MODEL: writer reads CollectionConfig + scans media/artwork/video/manual dirs
  + pulls item_metadata rows + inlines launcher presets in use => writes .kart.

CODE LAYOUT: new module src/modules/kart/
  kartformat.h (constants, flags), kartmanifest.{h,cpp} (JSON IO),
  kartwriter.{h,cpp} (worker thread, progress signal),
  kartreader.{h,cpp} (peek manifest cheap, then extract),
  kartmanager.{h,cpp} (top-level, owned by ApplicationManager).

UI SURFACE: File menu Import/Export, drag-drop on MainWindow, CLI flags via cliargs.h.

SUB-ISSUES (B-plan, incremental):
  1. Foundation: kartformat + kartmanifest + zstd CMake gate
  2. KartReader (read-only consume) + integrity verification
  3. KartWriter (export)
  4. KartManager + File menu integration + progress dialog
  5. Merge prompt UI for item_metadata collisions
  6. Drag-drop on MainWindow
  7. CLI flags --import-kart / --export-kart
notes:
Design locked 2026-05-05. Work proceeds via children: Kartend-y3iy (foundation), Kartend-vvvk (Reader), Kartend-a1za (Writer), Kartend-zgaq (Manager+UI), Kartend-ts9s (merge prompt), Kartend-ixvk (drag-drop), Kartend-w9c9 (CLI). This umbrella stays open until all 7 close.
All 7 sub-issues completed (uncommitted): y3iy (foundation), vvvk (Reader), a1za (Writer), zgaq (KartManager+UI), ts9s (merge prompt), ixvk (drag-drop), w9c9 (CLI). Filed Kartend-m2n2 for the per-item metadata persistence layer + activating the merge prompt at import time (DatabaseManager doesn't expose QSqlDatabase, so this is a separate plumbing change). Umbrella stays open until that follow-up closes.

value: AttractManager drives selection changes itself; the InteractionManager wiring for SelectionManager::selectionChanged → onActivityDetected must skip when AttractManager::isDrivingSelection() is true, otherwise the first advance tick stops attract mode.

Kartend-5h6 / Kartend-dd8 reinforced: clang-tidy --maintenance --apply-fixes ALSO mangles CollectionConfig() — when an explicit empty constructor is replaced with '= default' the auto-fixer can leave a stray 'default;' after it. Always inspect collectionutils.h after running --apply-fixes; expect manual cleanup.

Kartend-bdl: multi-launcher data model — CollectionConfig keeps the legacy launcherPath/corePath/launchParameters fields as the implicit primary launcher (index 0). Extra launchers live in CollectionConfig::additionalLaunchers (LauncherConfig list) at indices 1..N. defaultLauncherIndex is the unified index. helpers: launcherCount(), launcherAt(int), launcherDisplayName(int). LauncherConfig has same field names as CollectionConfig's legacy launcher fields, so launcherAt() must qualify member references with this-> to avoid ambiguous lookup during aggregate init (clang-21). LaunchManager::buildLaunchCommand has two overloads: the new (LauncherConfig, collectionName, filePath) is the canonical path; the old (CollectionConfig, filePath) is a thin wrapper for backward compatibility with existing tests.

Qt: a single QMenu can appear in multiple parent menus/menu bars by adding its menuAction() to each — the QMenu object is shared, not duplicated. Used in MenuController::setupHamburgerMenu() so the toolbar hamburger popup mirrors the menu bar without re-parenting; later additions to a top-level menu (e.g. setupFullscreenAction inserting into menuView) appear in both places automatically.

Settings dialog dirty-tracking gotcha: hasUnsavedChanges() splits checks across check{Basic,Extension,TreeName,ParentCollection,LinkedParents,Dimension,Color,ListMode,Background}Changes(). When adding a new per-collection field, you MUST also extend the appropriate check*Changes helper or the user's edits silently disappear: typing into the unrecognized field doesn't enable the Save button, and clicking OK calls resolveUnsavedChanges → hasUnsavedChanges() → false → dialog closes without persisting. This is what bit headerLogoImage, headerLogoPosition, vignetteEnabled, vignetteIntensity, AND backgroundVideo (the Video radio's selection wasn't recognized either). Fix: extend checkColorChanges (theme-adjacent fields) and checkBackgroundChanges (bg-radio + bg path).

Toolbar overlay vs. layout-member pattern: BackdropBlurOverlay (Kartend-eq8r) and BackgroundVideoWidget (Kartend-vbs) are FREE-FLOATING children of their parent (use parent eventFilter for resize, raise/lower for z-order, WA_TransparentForMouseEvents). HeaderLogoOverlay (Kartend-guo5) is a REAL LAYOUT MEMBER (sizeHint drives placement, NavigationManager inserts/removes from QHBoxLayout based on chosen anchor). When adding new toolbar overlays, pick based on whether the user wants it to push other widgets aside (layout-member) or sit on top of them (overlay).

InteractionStateHolder is main-thread-only by contract. All m_state-> reads in ArtworkManager occur in main-thread methods. QtConcurrent::run lambdas in artworkmanager.cpp use static helpers (processBatch, processPrecacheBatch) that never touch m_state — they snapshot value-typed inputs and post results back via QMetaObject::invokeMethod. If you need a flag inside a worker lambda, snapshot it before dispatch.

Kartend-7vi: usage stats (play_count/last_played/total_play_seconds on items table) tracked via LaunchManager callbacks (onLaunched, onPlaySessionEnded) wired in interactionmanagersetup.cpp to DatabaseManager. This callback indirection keeps test_launchmanager from needing the database module at link time. Time-played requires runtime detection (Kartend-qxv) — detached launches only update play_count/last_played.

Kartend-dd8: clang-tidy auto-fixer in '.scripts/build.sh --maintenance --apply-fixes --format-apply' MANGLES collectionutils.h (and other unrelated headers like uiconstants/, applicationcontext.h, filterhelpers.cpp, gamepadmanagerinput.cpp). It corrupted brace placement in stringToAlignment/stringToViewType, splitting tokens across braces. Always run plain '--maintenance' first to see warnings; only apply fixes interactively per-file. Never blanket-run with --apply-fixes after broad edits.

Runtime detection (Kartend-qxv): added optional General setting 'runtimeDetectionEnabled' (default OFF). When ON, LaunchManager spawns a tracked QProcess (parented to itself, ForwardedChannels for stdio passthrough) instead of QProcess::startDetached. Emits runtimeStarted(filePath, displayName)/runtimeFinished(filePath). MainWindow owns NowPlayingOverlay (in src/ui/widgets/) and shows it on start, hides + raise()/activateWindow() on finish. Only one tracked child at a time. Both finished() and errorOccurred(FailedToStart) funnel through a single cleanup lambda to keep the started/finished signal pair balanced.

VirtualScrollEngine (Kartend-158) extracted the 21 virtual-scrolling methods from scrollmanagervirtual.cpp into a real class via friend + back-pointer pattern. Canonical state (m_metrics, m_activeWidgets, m_virtualContainer, m_totalItems, m_emptyViewDebugBudget, m_destroying, m_context) stays on ScrollManager so sibling TUs (scrollmanagerfilter.cpp, scrollmanagersubcollection.cpp, etc.) compile unchanged. Engine accesses state via friendship; ScrollManager methods are now thin forwarders. True state migration into the engine deferred — would require a large callsite sweep across multiple TUs.

DetailPageManager (Kartend-uve) reuses SidebarManager::currentItemContext() instead of duplicating the showAllSubcollectionItems-aware owner+UUID+artwork/video/manual-directory resolution. SidebarManager publishes the resolved context at the end of updateSidebarMetadata; siblings read it via the const accessor. Pattern to follow when adding more selection-driven views.

Filter-aware index discrimination: when a search filter can be active, never compare a visual index directly against subs.size() to decide subcollection-vs-item. Always route through ScrollManager::getFilteredIndex(visualIndex) → actualIndex first, then compare actualIndex < subs.size() AND index subs[actualIndex]. The originalIndex range used by FilterManager is [0..subCount) for subcollections then subCount.. for media.

DatabaseManager exit-crash root cause: m_workerThread = new QThread(this) parents thread to manager, then ~DatabaseManager calls quit() without wait() - ~QObject auto-deletes the child QThread mid-flight, ~QThread qFatals on still-running thread. Fix: don't parent QThread, do quit + bounded wait(2000ms) in destructor, leak intentionally on timeout (matches existing OS-cleanup pattern in QueryManager/CacheManager/ArtworkManager). main.cpp uses std::quick_exit(0) so leaks don't matter at process exit.

Search-mode discriminator: NEVER use getSubcollections(parentIdx).size() to test sub-vs-media for the *current* collection. The DB-backed search modes (CurrentCollection / CurrentAndSubcollections / AllCollections) bypass FilterManager entirely (so getFilteredIndex is a no-op) and NavigationManager::onItemCountLoaded filters subs down to a context.subcollectionOverride that gets rendered. Always use ScrollManager::getSubcollectionCount() / getVirtualFolderCount() and ScrollManager::getDataManager()->subcollectionIndexFromActual().

Kartend-dnx4: per-item launcher override stored as item_metadata.launcher_index (NULLable INT, -1 in struct = NULL in DB). LaunchManager consults via setup.resolveLauncherOverride callback wired in interactionmanagersetup.cpp — same callback indirection pattern as onLaunched/onPlaySessionEnded so test_launchmanager doesn't need DatabaseManager at link time. Override is silent (skips chooser) but ONLY when the caller didn't pass an explicit launcherIndex — explicit launches (UI 'Launch with...') win over the persisted pin. Context menu entries 'Always launch with...' and 'Clear launcher override' only appear when the owning collection has launcherCount() > 1.

Kartend-p1jd: launcher presets stored as a top-level [Launchers] QSettings array, NOT inside [General]. Each preset has a stable UUID id (QUuid::createUuid().toString(QUuid::WithoutBraces)) so renames don't break references from collection LauncherConfig::presetId. Resolution via LauncherUtils::resolvePreset() in collectionutils.h: when presetId matches, preset's name+path+core+params replace inline fields; missing preset falls back to inline (typically empty → clear launch error). LauncherEditorDialog accepts an optional QList<LauncherPreset> — non-empty enables a 'Use preset' combo that locks the form fields when a preset is picked. Per-preset edit reuses the same dialog with empty availablePresets so the combo is hidden (presets can't reference other presets). Preset state mutates m_generalSettings.launcherPresets directly on the dialog; saveGeneralSettingsFromUI mirrors it onto mainWindow before persisting.
Kartend integration test harness (Kartend-785): kartend_lib OBJECT library compiles all src TUs

List-mode artwork preview button (view-preview icon) requires hasArtwork=true on ItemWidget. createMediaItemWidget uses findArtworkForFileCached which returns empty on cold cache; the safety net reconfigureArtworkForActiveWidgets calls configureArtworkForWidget after prewarm, but that function previously only handled GRID mode (queueing pixmap loads) and never updated setHasArtwork for list-mode widgets. This way the post-prewarm reconfigure path correctly toggles the artwork button visibility for list-mode rows.

When a maintenance run fails after apply-fixes, inspect git diff and revert mangled files that you didn't intentionally edit.

FilterManager::setContext (Kartend-ks4n) auto-derives the hideMissingArtwork flag and artwork directory from the CollectionContext it's given. Means callers do NOT need to explicitly push the flag — every existing applyFilter / applySubcollectionFilter call site picks it up automatically because they all call setContext beforehand. The clearFilter() path was extended too: when hideMissingArtwork is on, clearFilter does NOT transition to the unfiltered passthrough, instead it builds an artwork-only baseline (every subcollection + media items that resolve to artwork) and keeps m_isFiltered=true so getActualIndex still routes through m_filteredIndices.

Kartend-fse: launch history (launch_history table, DB v9). HistoryStore (src/utils/historystore.{h,cpp}) is the SQL access layer; DatabaseManager exposes recordHistoryEntry/loadRecentHistory/historyEntryCount/clearHistory on the main-thread connection. Recording reuses the existing onLaunched callback in interactionmanagersetup.cpp (same hook stats use) — gated by GeneralSettings.historyEnabled with a post-insert trim to GeneralSettings.historyMaxEntries (clamped [10,50000], 0/negative means unlimited). Unlike usage stats (aggregate on items table), history is append-only — duplicate (uuid, path) rows are intentional. UI lives as a fourth tab in StatisticsDialog; the tab carries its own Disable toggle and Clear button, scoped so the global Reset button still only touches stats. TRIM SQL gotcha: use strict 'id <' with OFFSET=N-1, not 'id <=' (off-by-one drops the cutoff row itself).

Launch path validation: media paths are passed to QProcess::startDetached(program, arguments) without shell interpretation, so ampersands in filenames such as 'Sonic & Knuckles' are safe and should not be rejected as shell metacharacters.

QJsonObject in Qt 6 sorts keys alphabetically (NOT insertion order). For ordered key/value JSON, either accept alphabetical sorting in the UI or serialize as a JSON array of pairs. ItemMetadataStore::parseCustomFields/serializeCustomFields use the alphabetical-object form for stable rendering.

Schema migration v5 added item_metadata(collection_uuid+path) — single table for Kartend-rx64 (extended fields) + reserves manual_path for Kartend-9jdv and custom_fields JSON blob for Kartend-hpln. Sidebar Details section is built dynamically (no .ui edit) and skipped when ItemMetadata::isEmpty(). Reads use the main-thread DatabaseManager connection; writes will be added when scrapers/edit dialogs land. Update test_dbmigrations CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION assertions in BOTH appliesToCurrentVersion AND v3AddsMetaTable when bumping (subtle: the latter checks final version, not v3 specifically).

Items viewport overlay z-order (Kartend-vbs/guo5/qbp3): BackgroundVideoWidget lowered to back; default Qt children (scroll widget) in middle; VignetteOverlay raised above scroll widget; HeaderLogoOverlay raised above vignette so logo stays bright if it's in a corner. Re-established every applyBackgroundForCollection call so external raise/lower can't leave layers wrong. All overlays use WA_TransparentForMouseEvents + parent eventFilter for resize tracking.

Per-collection video bg uses a dedicated BackgroundVideoWidget (Kartend-vbs), NOT reused VideoPreviewWidget. Reasons: VideoPreviewWidget plays audio at full volume + uses KeepAspectRatio (letterbox) which is wrong for a fill-the-rect background. BackgroundVideoWidget is muted, has no QAudioOutput attached, and uses KeepAspectRatioByExpanding centered (cover-fit). Mounted as a child of itemScrollArea->viewport(), lowered behind the scroll widget; viewport stylesheet set to transparent so the video shows through. WA_TransparentForMouseEvents so it doesn't eat clicks.

UI-coordinator managers (NavigationManager, ApplicationManager, ScrollManager, InteractionManager) directly include ui_*.h headers. Pure unit tests are not viable — they need an integration harness with QApplication + MainWindow fixture. Helpers split out into separate files (navigationhelpers, scrollhelpers, etc.) ARE unit-testable and already covered.
